templates.label: OWASP checklist
templates.content:
# OWASP review checklist

- [ ] Injection: parameterized queries only
- [ ] Broken auth: session rotation and MFA considered
- [ ] Sensitive data: encrypted in transit and at rest
- [ ] XXE: external entity resolution disabled
- [ ] Access control: deny by default
- [ ] Security misconfiguration: defaults removed
- [ ] XSS: output encoding and CSP
- [ ] CSRF: tokens on state-changing requests
